name: limoni-mcp
description: Drive a running Limoni terminal app by its semantic tree: find, click, type, wait_for.
long_description: A bridge from MCP over stdio to a Limoni application's automation socket. Tools address widgets by role, label and value, the same tree a screen reader reads, instead of scraping characters and clicking coordinates. The application opts in with limoni.WithAutomation in a build tagged limoni_debug; secrets are redacted and every limit is enforced by the application.

socket.title: Automation socket
socket.description: Path of the Unix socket the application passed to limoni.WithAutomation.
